name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check
description: ADR-0003's library-CSS check for Quartz 5 packages: fails a stylesheet that reaches outside its BEM block, defines a name outside it, or sets its own colour or font. Run at build time; it rewrites nothing. See CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist. JavaScript with JSDoc types, not TypeScript, because a plugin's build.mjs imports it straight into Node, which won't strip types from a file under node_modules, where a downstream install puts it (docs/adr/0001).
//dependencies: The parsers the check reads CSS with. A consuming package installs them through this library: the pnpm workspace on main, npm under the library's published version downstream (ADR-0005).
